notes.title: Halloween Update (Version 1.0.5)
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28845777/2af5fb01bbef9f7ccf85b016d6c270cfbd80c80d.png

Hi Terries!

To celebrate Halloween –– and the Day of the Dead –– we have updated Necrosphere to allow all players access to the bonus level. We hope you enjoy this devious nightmare. 

Halloween Sale
A special 25% OFF Halloween Sale for new players!

Version 1.0.5
A FREE update to the Deluxe version that unlocks Terry's Dream Bonus Level!
For those interested, the DLC contains Necrosphere's Original Soundtrack by Juliane Andrezzo. We appreciate your support!

Terry's Dream (Bonus Level)

While inside the Necrosphere, agent Terry Cooper has a lucid dream that removes everything he has gathered so far –– even his clothes.

Collect 5 DVDs to unlock this bonus level at the Main Screen.
Progress is not saved while within Terry's Dream. Muahahaha...

Don't forget to let us know what you think in our discussions page!

notes.title: Necrosphere 1.0.3 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hello Terries! Today we've pushed live some bug fixes to help ensure you can escape the afterlife more comfortably. Please keep the feedback coming in our discussions
 page, we love it.

Terry's Dream (Deluxe only):

    Fixed a bad placed camera trigger
    Added quick fix to red screen bug on Terry's Dream (Available on the F1 Help Menu)

Final Zone:

    Improved autosave near the final portal

Purple zone:

    Fixed two dead-ends

Chore:

    Updated ending credits


Thanks for playing!

Edit: We jumped the version 1.0.2 because it was a broken build that we wrongly pushed live. We're sorry if you tried to play it for the 40 minutes range that it was available.

notes.title: Necrosphere 1.0.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hey there! Thanks for playing Necrosphere, I hope you are enjoying it. Today we've came up with some bugfixes and added a help menu with some requested features that can be accessed by pressing F1 ingame.

Help Menu (F1):

    Mute Sound
    Stop Audio Playback (gets rid of music)
    Frameskip On/Off (select ON on slow computers)
    Fullscreen/Windowed support

Purple Zone:

    Changed a spike to fireball in a specific area to avoid getting Terry stuck

Achievements:

    Fix Dreamcatcher
    Fix OCD
